card.name: Inside CYP enzyme names and linking words
card.fires_on: The letter or digit partway through CYP enzyme names such as 2D6, 1A1 and 3A. Also small linking words like 'whether', 'the' and 'least' in drug-interaction and nursing-mother sentences.

modes.label: CYP enzyme names
modes.description: The middle or final character of a CYP enzyme code such as 2D6, 3A or 1A1.
modes.example: Concomitant use of tricyclic antidepressants with drugs that can inhibit cytochrome P450 2<<D>>6 may require lower doses than usually prescribed

modes.label: Linking words in warnings
modes.description: A small word like 'whether' or 'the' just before the subject of a drug-effect or excretion statement.
modes.example: It is not known<< whether>> simvastatin is excreted
